"/><img class="bcorp-logo" alt="Certified B Corporation" src="data:image/png;base64,"><span>× STARNEWS</span></span><span>CONFIDENTIAL · proposal · OCTOBER 2026</span></footer>
<script>
(function(){
  // Bind the last two words of each text block so no line ends on a single word.
  document.querySelectorAll('main *, footer *').forEach(function(el){
    if(/^(SCRIPT|STYLE|IMG|TABLE|TBODY|THEAD|TR|DETAILS)$/.test(el.tagName) || el.querySelector('br:not(.dsk)')) return;
    if(el.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<4) return;
    var w=document.createTreeWalker(el,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,null),n,list=[];
    while((n=w.nextNode())){ if(n.nodeValue.trim()) list.push(n); }
    if(!list.length) return;
    var last=list[list.length-1], v=last.nodeValue;
    var m=v.match(/^([\s\S]*\S)\s+(\S+\s*)$/);
    if(m){ last.nodeValue=m[1]+'\u00A0'+m[2]; return; }
    var prev=list[list.length-2];
    if(prev && /\s$/.test(prev.nodeValue)) prev.nodeValue=prev.nodeValue.replace(/\s+$/,'\u00A0');
  });
  // Open every expandable card when printing or saving to PDF.
  var opened=[];
  window.addEventListener('beforeprint',function(){document.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(function(d){if(!d.open){d.open=true;opened.push(d);}});});
  window.addEventListener('afterprint',function(){opened.forEach(function(d){d.open=false;});opened=[];});
})();
</script>
</body></html>
